newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B index up at noon in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B index up at noon in thin trade.

text.p: Shenzhen's B shares edged up at midday on Tuesday but trading remained thin as investors awaited the release of more 1996 company results, brokers said.
The B share index gained 0.12 points or 0.08 percent to 159.40 on turnover of HK$33.55 million.
"The market is hardly moving because investors are waiting for fresh market-moving news," an analyst with J&A Securities said.
The bulk of company results have still to be released with the official deadline of April 30 approaching, making investors reluctant to enter the market, traders said.
"B share trading is likely to stay cool during the remainder of the corporate results reporting season," said an analyst at a western bank in Shenzhen.
Analysts said they expected the B share index to drop in the afternoon, in line with a fall in A shares in the morning.
The A share index was down 3.01 points or 0.66 percent at 456.08 points at noon on turnover of 3.8 billion yuan.
Shenzhen Health Mineral Water Co Ltd was the star performer in the B share market, rising HK$0.34 or 7.62 percent to HK$4.80 based on a single trade of 100 shares.
